messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up — proposing a coordinated bump to v2.15.0 tonight. US window 02:00-03:00 UTC, EU 03:30-04:30 UTC, APAC 12:00-13:00 UTC local (APAC ops will confirm). Can people confirm branch freeze and changelog readiness?
AJ: tagging in. freeze starts 01:30 UTC for us (so we can cut release at 02:00). Changelog PRs pls get in before 01:00 so we can do a quick pass.
Devon: there's one outstanding DB migration in #4521 that needs canary gating. Recommend feature-flagging it and enabling only in US canary first.
Maria: agreed — we'll do canary in US (10% traffic) then EU fallback, then full roll. Devon can you add the flag and the rollout plan in the PR?
Devon: on it. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4521 — flag: feat.denorm_migration (default off). I'll add a rollout matrix in the PR description.
Liam: Ops question — are we comfortable with the warmup window for Dedicated pools? Current plan warms GPUs 20m before cut. For APAC that's midday spike; maybe extend to 30m to avoid cold starts?
Zara: +1 on 30m for APAC. Also reminder — Dedicated customers in EU have a maintenance blackout 04:00-05:00 CET tomorrow, so avoid any EU-only rollbacks in that hour.
AJ: noted. I'll update the release playbook with the 30m warmup for APAC and the EU blackout exception.
sre-bot: deploy-scheduler: Canary scheduled: US 02:10 UTC (10% traffic), EU 03:40 UTC (5% traffic), APAC 12:10 local (5% traffic). Full rollout windows reserved after 30m if metrics ok.
Kate: Quick changelog nudge — please add a one-line entry under "Services" about the migration and the flag, not the whole migration SQL. Keeps the changelog readable for product.
Maria: good point, Kate. I'll do the copy editing after Devon updates PR.
Devon: PR updated with rollout matrix + basic runbook steps. Also added a quick smoke test script:
```
# smoke test
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v2/health | jq .status
```
Will add a small validators job in CI.
AJ: thanks. One more note: branch protection requires 1 approval from eng leads and green CI. Can reviewers give quick LGTM for non-blocking docs?
Zara: I can review infra bits.
Liam: I'll take the deployment/ops bits.
Kate: doing changelog pass now.
Maria: final checklist for tonight:
- Devon: finalize flag + PR (done)
- Reviewers: LGTM by 01:15 UTC
- Changelog: Kate edits by 01:00 UTC
- Ops: adjust warmup (AJ) + confirm Dedicated pools by 01:20 UTC
- SRE bot: schedule canary (sre-bot)
If anything slips, call abort and we shift APAC to next window.
AJ: for visibility, tagging @here in case anyone else needs to opt-out of their scheduled jobs in those windows.
Maria: thanks all — ping me in thread if you hit blockers. I'll cut the tag once LGTM & green CI. :thumbsup:
